## Project Overview

For this assignment, I developed a professional portfolio website using Quarto and Positron to demonstrate my understanding of website development, analytics dashboards, CSS/SCSS customization, and automated portfolio listings.

The website highlights my academic background, professional experience, technical skills, and graduate-level marketing analytics projects.

## Website Components

### 1. Home Page

Introduces my professional background, education, technical skills, work experience, and career aspirations in digital marketing and analytics.

### 2. Quarto Dashboard

Showcases my Culminating Experience Project with Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy, including GA4 measurement, conversion tracking, and marketing performance indicators.

### 3. CSS/SCSS Customization

Demonstrates how CSS and SCSS can improve website appearance, typography, navigation, and design consistency.

### 4. Portfolio Listings

Uses Quarto Listings to automatically organize and display selected academic and marketing analytics projects.

## Learning Reflection

This assignment strengthened my understanding of how Quarto can be used to create and publish professional websites.

I gained hands-on experience developing website navigation, organizing content, building dashboards, applying custom styling, and implementing automated portfolio listings.

I also learned how to use GitHub and GitHub Pages to share analytical work with a broader audience.

These skills will be valuable for communicating future marketing research findings, developing analytics reports, and presenting professional projects.
